checks: Academic calendar uses authored dates, holidays, vacations, and UTC-safe arithmetic
Thirty broadcasts preserve exact regular and special dates, including holiday Thursday
Map never leaks an unknown heroine or the concealed Thursday broadcaster
Daily talk respects heroine multipliers, integer minimum, scene caps, and existing progress
Drafts, canceling, and unscheduled weeks do not submit a letter or change anonymous affection
A sent letter freezes its actual subject, alias, and text; one per week
Broadcast reading occurs independently from player listening and settles rival reaction exactly once
Partial listening, finishing, repeated finishing, and replay produce distinct idempotent records
Hiatus emits a rerun without reading letters, counting a new broadcast, or granting clues
Anonymous heroine letters are recognized only from actual prior knowledge
Story priority, dates, broadcast gates, and knowledge-dependent choices follow the GDD
Fair fallback is a real meeting and festival never invents a message from an unknown heroine
Rainy work scene includes the third heroine only at her actual Wednesday evening location
Save restore preserves in-progress branches, charged costs, pending wages, and once-only effects
First-build checkpoint migrates into continued play without pretending the story ended
Gift transactions enforce money, inventory, actual meetings, seven days and birthday multipliers
Dates guard commitments and resources, rotate conversations, and settle an album entry only once
Nari refuses karaoke on two distinct invitations and Room 3 requires the actual river revelation
Jealousy is observer-specific, once daily, first awareness only below 55, and Nari speaks through the radio
Social save validation restores old saves with empty bags and rejects broken inventory and unfinished-date metadata
A seeded itinerary survives reload and repeated visits, never places one heroine in two places, and conceals Thursday
Encounter probabilities reflect shifts, absences and exams rather than guaranteed daily attendance
Older saves receive a stable itinerary seed and malformed seeds are rejected
Free conversations and gifts cannot teleport people by unlocking a new route in the same time slot
Clothes follow performance, rehearsal, dates and seasons while retaining an explicit scene selection
scope: Pure calendar, radio lifecycle, relationship rules, story conditions, and save contracts. Does not certify visual layout or full-game completion.
